items.text: Ladd McConkey ruled out mid-game with concussion after evaluation for head injury.
items.implication: Chargers WR volume shifts; monitor for next week protocol
items.opportunity: Increased targets for remaining Chargers WRs like Quentin Johnston

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive for Browns. Only depth is Jaleel McLaughlin and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings PS). Prior GTD to OUT.
items.why: Ankle; limited practice, pregame workout failed
items.implication: Browns RB committee of McLaughlin/Estime; avoid Judkins, stream depth if available
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for McLaughlin and Estime

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active for Titans/Colts game.
items.implication: Colts TE streamers up; targets to Downs/Allen likely rise
items.opportunity: TE replacement and Colts pass-catcher volume

items.text: DJ Moore is out (inactive) for Bills.
items.implication: Bills WR targets redistribute; Josh Palmer active
items.opportunity: Palmer and other Bills WRs snap/target share increase

items.text: Actives: Caleb Williams, Rico Dowdle, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane. Inactives: Judkins, Warren.
items.implication: Clears several for start; confirms outs
items.opportunity: Full roles for actives; depth for outs

items.text: Still starting Cam Skattebo if forced (explosiveness vs NO for score chance) but riskier flex than RB2 now post-rotation news; ranked RB28. Why on preseason hate list.
items.why: Najee larger role expected after fumbles; still likes upside
items.conflict: Usage shift vs residual start recommendation

items.text: Cam Skattebo 37th/43 in rush YOE and 4 fumbles (1 lost). Giants expect larger Najee Harris role, Skattebo downgraded but still mixed; all 4 RBs active.
items.why: Fumbles and poor efficiency; coach comments on role change
items.implication: Riskier flex; prefer other options or monitor Harris share
items.opportunity: Najee Harris role expansion; Skattebo still explosive but reduced

items.text: Weekend summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb Williams/Olave/Kamara/AJ Brown/Henderson/Metcalf/Freiermuth/Sadiq; Not expected Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue.
items.implication: Core status tracking for lineup decisions; many expected cleared

items.text: Eagles placed QB Jalen Hurts on IR; signed RB Jaydon Blue to active roster.
items.implication: Backup QB start; Eagles offense downgrade ROS short-term
items.opportunity: Blue activation; Wicks/Goedert etc. in new scheme

items.text: Watching late: Davante Adams (leg), Ladd McConkey (concussion), Dalton Kincaid (ribs, returned), Romeo Doubs (shoulder), Rashod Bateman (shoulder), Darnell Mooney (neck).
items.implication: Monitor for Week 7 availability; Kincaid cleared return
items.opportunity: Handcuffs or replacements if OUT next

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson and AJ Brown both officially active for Patriots.
items.why: Ankle for both; likely play confirmed
items.implication: Full-ish Patriots offense; start both if rostered

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today.
items.implication: Titans RB committee with Pollard; stream if needed post-Warren news

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (RB5), Javonte Williams (RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9) for volume vs leaky run Ds. Hates Woody Marks, JK Dobbins, Croskey-Merritt.
items.why: Elite usage/matchups for loves; tough Ds/role issues for hates
items.implication: Prioritize loves in lineups; fade hates
items.opportunity: Goal-line and volume for loved RBs

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (WR4), Drake London (WR6), Matthew Golden (WR11), George Kittle (TE3) vs soft Commanders or usage. Hates Jaylen Waddle, Emeka Egbuka, Kyle Pitts.
items.why: Matchup buffet vs WAS; usage bankable; ugly matchups/QB for hates
